The key's 7 Westferry Circus address is out of date. Companies House also shows Revolut Bank UK Ltd (12871051) as Active, incorporated 10 Sep 2020, at the same address. k2.disputed_point: Which entity's directors and PSCs are meant (Revolut Ltd 08804411 in the key, Revolut Bank UK Ltd 12871051 in Answer A), and whether Storonsky and Yatsenko are individual PSCs.
k2.why: Answer A screened a different company, Revolut Bank UK Ltd (12871051, formerly Revolut Newco UK Ltd). Its officers are different, and its sole PSC is Revolut Group Holdings Ltd. That does not contradict the key, which is about Revolut Ltd (08804411). On the Revolut Ltd pages I opened, the only active PSC is Revolut Group Holdings Ltd (75% or more of shares and voting rights, notified 29 April 2022). Storonsky was a PSC (more than 25% to 50% of shares) from 2016 but ceased on 29 April 2022. Yatsenko is not listed as a PSC. The key's hedged wording ('possibly listed') is therefore only partly right: Storonsky is a ceased PSC, not a current one. Current officers of Revolut Ltd include Storonskiy (director since 2013), Yatsenko (director since 2017) and Martin Gilbert (director since 2020). Others are Britton, Jajodia, Sherwood, Sievwright, Teodosiu and Wilson, and the secretary is Heather Fleming. Gilbert's role as chair of Revolut Group Holdings is not shown on these pages, and I did not check it. Answer A's separate finding that Storonskiy is a PSC of Group Holdings (more than 25% to 50%) matches the key's 'roughly 20-25% shareholder' only loosely, and I did not open that page. The key's core content holds, with that PSC nuance.
k2.corrected_answer: Key people: Nikolay (Nik) Storonsky, founder and CEO, and Vlad Yatsenko, co-founder and director of the group, are both current directors of Revolut Ltd (08804411). Martin Gilbert is also a director and chair of Revolut Group Holdings. Other current directors are Caroline Britton, Siddhartha Jajodia, Michael Sherwood, John Sievwright, Dan Teodosiu and Ian Wilson. The secretary is Heather Fleming (since June 2025). The only active PSC of Revolut Ltd is its parent, Revolut Group Holdings Ltd (75% or more of shares and voting rights, since 29 April 2022). Storonsky was an individual PSC (more than 25% to 50% of shares) until 29 April 2022, when the PSC entry ceased. Yatsenko is not listed as a PSC. Storonsky is the largest individual shareholder, at roughly 20-25% by press reports. He holds British nationality on Companies House and was Russian-born. Note: if the intended entity is Revolut Bank UK Ltd (12871051), its directors differ (Alcaix, Carlesi, Estlin, Fry, Holmes, Kapoor, Wilson) and its active PSC is also Revolut Group Holdings Ltd.
